results.title: Render Workspace Fees After the End of Seat Pricing | Forte Blog
results.snippet:
Take a hypothetical API with $18 in monthly Render service charges. Hobby adds no workspace fee. If the same API still costs $18 to run after the team moves to Pro, the $25 workspace fee brings the total to $43 before tax. A third developer can join without increasing that workspace fee. These are illustrative service charges using Render's published billing structure, not a quote for a particular app. [...] Teams

# Render Workspace Fees After the End of Seat Pricing

Render no longer charges per seat. See when the $25 Pro workspace fee applies and how to compare it with your service costs.

Bandwidth past the included amount is $0.15 per GB. Persistent disks are $0.25 per GB a month. Pro's $25 is per workspace, not per seat.

## What each service costs [...] Two parts: a workspace plan (Hobby $0, Pro $25, Scale $499 a month, per Render's pricing page read November 16, 2026) plus a fixed monthly price for each service. The smallest paid web service is $7 (512 MB) and the smallest paid Postgres is $6 (256 MB), so a small app runs about $13 a month on Hobby.

### Is Render Pro $25 per user?

No. Render lists Pro at $25 a month plus compute, with unlimited seats and services. You pay the $25 once for the workspace, then pay for each service you run. results.title: Render Pricing 2026: Free Tier Sleep, Plans, Compute | Temps
results.snippet:
No. In April 2026 Render replaced its per-member plans with flat workspace fees: Pro ($25/month flat) replaced Professional ($19 per member per month), and Scale ($499/month flat) replaced Organization ($29 per member per month), per Render's changelog. Pro and Scale include unlimited seats. Hobby stays at one seat, so a team of two or more needs Pro.

## What Does a Production App on Render Cost?

Three worked examples, using the list prices above (no bandwidth overage): [...] > TL;DR: Hobby is $0 + compute (1 seat, 25 services, 5 GB bandwidth). Pro is $25/month + compute (unlimited seats, 25 GB). Scale is $499/month + compute (multiple workspaces, SAML SSO, 1 TB). Web services cost $0 (Free, sleeps), then $7/month for 512 MB and $25/month for 2 GB. Postgres starts at $6/month. Upgrading the workspace plan does not stop a Free service from sleeping — moving the service to a paid instance does, on any plan.

## What Are Render's Workspace Plans in 2026? [...] No. Since April 2026, Pro is $25/month flat per workspace with unlimited seats, plus compute. It replaced the per-member Professional plan ($19 per member). Scale ($499/month flat) replaced Organization ($29 per member).
